## Design Overview

**Package layout** (`bench/` package plus a thin `tools/` CLI shim):

```
bench/
  __init__.py
  process.py        # EngineProcess / GpuMonitor / ProcessSupervisor
  config.py         # BenchmarkConfig, VerifyConfig, AnalysisConfig, load_config
  artifacts.py      # ArtifactWriter, manifest/log/requests/parity writers
  analysis.py       # analyze_rows (moved unchanged from analyze_window_union)
  benchmark.py      # run_benchmark (matrix screen)
  verify.py         # run_verify (parity harness)
tests/
  test_process.py
  test_config.py
  test_artifacts.py
  test_benchmark.py
  test_verify.py
  test_analysis.py
tools/
  bench_dflash_matrix.py   # argparse shim -> bench.benchmark.main
  check_verify_scratch.py  # argparse shim -> bench.verify.main
  analyze_window_union.py  # argparse shim -> bench.analysis.main
```
